description:
`notify` takes an incoming notification request — POST a `msg` envelope, or send a message over SMTP if you can only send email — and delivers it to your platform notifications, plus any external notification service you've set as your notification preference — an email to your primary address, an HTTP notification to Discord or WhatsApp, a push notification such as ntfy, or more than one destination at once through a broadcast (`/b/`) group.

`notify`, like most notification services, is free. Some external destinations may offer a paid option for advanced features.
name: notify

payout_price.description: No platform commission — delivers to the caller's own configured destination

summary: POST a `msg` envelope and UnitySVC delivers it to your platform notifications and any external destination you've configured — no recipient or channel to specify.
